# SHUUL Technologies

> SHUUL Technologies is a next-gen AI SaaS product company based in Pune, Maharashtra, India. We build and own AI products that make complexity invisible. Our flagship product is SuperHospitality, an AI concierge for hotels.

DPIIT Startup India recognized. Corporate domain: shuul.io

## Company

- Entity: SHUUL Technologies LLP (registered in India)
- Corporate domain: shuul.io
- Location: Pune, Maharashtra, India
- Recognition: DPIIT Startup India

## Products

### SuperHospitality — AI concierge for hotels

Guests send requests via WhatsApp or a web app using text, voice notes, or calls. The AI understands the request, routes the task to the right staff member, and closes the loop — no app downloads, no missed calls, no manual relay. Managers get real-time operational visibility.
